en.tagline: Manage Notion pages, databases and blocks through the API
en.summary: This skill gives you Notion API calls for pages, databases and blocks. It covers setup, authentication, the required Notion-Version header and common reads and writes. It also explains the 2025-09-03 change, where databases become data sources with two IDs.
problem: Working with Notion from code means calling the API directly. You need an integration key, a version header, and the right ID for each call. Pages and databases must also be shared with the integration before the API can access them.

The skill writes out curl commands for common tasks. It also explains the 2025-09-03 changes. A database now has both a database_id and a data_source_id, and each one is used with different endpoints.
fit: Adding database items with title, select, date and other properties
Reading page content and blocks from a script
Querying a database with filters and sorts
unfit: Changing database view filters, which the API cannot do
Working with pages that have not been shared with the integration
steps: Create an integration at notion.so/my-integrations and copy its API key.
Share each target page or database with the integration using Connect to.
Send requests to api.notion.com with a Bearer token and the `Notion-Version: 2025-09-03` header.
Use `database_id` when creating pages and `data_source_id` when querying a database.
Read or change pages, data sources and blocks with the curl examples in the skill.

zh.tagline: 通过 API 管理 Notion 页面、数据库和块
zh.summary: 这个技能提供一组 Notion API 调用示例，用于操作页面、数据库和块。内容包括初始配置、认证方式、必需的 Notion-Version 请求头，以及常见的读取和写入操作。它还说明了 2025-09-03 版本的变化：数据库改称数据源，并拆分出两个 ID。
problem: 在代码中使用 Notion，意味着要直接调用 API。你需要集成密钥、版本请求头，并且每次调用都要用对 ID。页面和数据库还必须先共享给集成，API 才能访问它们。
这个技能把常见操作的请求写成了可以直接使用的 curl 命令，并说明了 2025-09-03 版本的变化。数据库现在同时有 database_id 和 data_source_id，两者用于不同的接口。
fit: 向数据库添加条目，并设置标题、单选、日期等属性
通过脚本读取页面内容和块
按筛选和排序条件查询数据库
unfit: 修改数据库视图的筛选条件，API 无法完成这项操作
操作尚未共享给集成的页面
steps: 在 notion.so/my-integrations 创建集成，并复制其 API 密钥。
在 Notion 中通过“Connect to”把目标页面或数据库共享给集成。
请求 api.notion.com 时附带 Bearer 令牌和 `Notion-Version: 2025-09-03` 请求头。
创建页面时使用 `database_id`，查询数据库时使用 `data_source_id`。
按技能中的 curl 示例读取或修改页面、数据源和块。
